attchmntText: Supreme Holdings & Hospitality (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Supreme Holdings and Hospitality India Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 228.48 Lakhs for the quarter and 450.08 Lakhs for the half year. Standalone profit after tax was 68.89 Lakhs for the quarter and 109.34 Lakhs for the half year. Consolidated revenue from operations was 228.48 Lakhs for the quarter and 450.08 Lakhs for the half year. Consolidated profit after tax was 67.00 Lakhs for the quarter and 101.71 Lakhs for the half year. The results were subjected to a Limited Review by Statutory Auditors. The Board meeting commenced at 15:00 hours and concluded at 16:52 hours.

attchmntText: Supreme Holdings & Hospitality (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication Pertaining the Postal Ballot Notice and E-voting information, published in Financial Express (English) and Loksatta (Marathi) on November 05, 2026.
Supreme Holdings & Hospitality (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot

Supreme Holdings & Hospitality (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on October 28, 2026, whereby the Board has considered and approved following: 1. Approval of Related Party Transaction (subject to approval of Shareholders of the Company by way of Postal Ballot), 2. Approval of Draft Notice of Postal Ballot for seeking approval of Shareholders. 3. Appointment of Scrutinizer.
